quality.numeric_confidence_policy: Secondary reproduction explicitly attributed to Environment Agency Pollution Inventory 2024 under OGL is capped at confidence 98 until the direct official raw PI row is read.
quality.year_policy: Only explicit 2024-column or definitive single-year 2024 Air annual-mass rows are promoted.
quality.adjacent_year_policy: Blank 2024 and populated 2025 is 2025-only and is never backfilled.
quality.source_path_policy: Binary disclosure/catalog paths are source-discovery evidence only unless a row is actually read and validated.
quality.duplicate_note: Both exact formatted and unformatted value+permit repository searches returned zero matches before publication.

official_source_paths.retrieval: Known official 2024 PI ZIP path retained; identical known binary-client failure was not loop-retried and no direct row is claimed.

semantic_guards: Renewable-fuel CO2 is a subset and is never added to total CO2.
Measured/Calculated/Estimated is a source reporting method, not project measured state.
Only explicit calendar-year 2024 Air annual-mass rows are promoted.
Explicit 2024 blank and 2025 populated means 2025-only, never zero.
Flattened mixed-year single values remain fail-closed until year placement is preserved.
APR values are not substituted for PI annual-mass rows.
Waste tonnage and permit limits are not annual emissions.
Direct official raw PI row remains required before numeric confidence >=99.
